Hi, I'm Nick. I'm an economist at U.S. Bank, where I build the economic scenarios the bank uses to test how it would hold up in a recession. Before that I spent four years at the Treasury Department working on international finance, from the IMF to Ukraine.

[Personal paragraph: where you live and grew up, who you live with, and what fills your time outside work.]

I like building things in R, and lately a lot of that has been with AI tools. This site is partly one of those projects: a handful of charts on the U.S. economy that I keep up to date, many of them extending analyses I thought deserved to stay current.

## Charts I'm watching

- [The AI economy](ai-economy.qmd): investment, adoption, and productivity
- [Interest rates](interest-rates.qmd): the 10-year Treasury yield and who is supplying long-term debt
- [Inflation](inflation.qmd): measures of consumer price inflation
